sloka: ददर्श वध्यमानांश्च क्लिश्यमानांश्च देहिनः ।क्रोशतश्च महानादं तीव्रनिष्टनतत्परान् ।। ७.२१.१२ ॥
transliteration: dadarśa vadhyamānāṁśca kliśyamānāṁśca dehinaḥ ।krośataśca mahānādaṁ tīvraniṣṭanatatparān ।। 7.21.12 ॥

translations.english: He saw embodied beings being killed and tormented, crying out with a great cry and intent on intense wailing.
